import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the comparison function prototype
gsl_comparison_fn_t = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p))

# Define the gsl_heapsort function prototype
gsl.gsl_heapsort.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, gsl_comparison_fn_t]
gsl.gsl_heapsort.restype = None

def compare_ints(a, b):
    """Comparison function for integers."""
    a_val = ctypes.cast(a, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)).contents.value
    b_val = ctypes.cast(b, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)).contents.value
    return (a_val > b_val) - (a_val < b_val)

def heapsort(array):
    """Sorts an array of integers using GSL's gsl_heapsort."""
    # Convert the input array to a ctypes array
    c_array = (ctypes.c_int * len(array))(*array)

    # Create a ctypes-compatible comparison function
    compare_fn = gsl_comparison_fn_t(compare_ints)

    # Call gsl_heapsort
    gsl.gsl_heapsort(c_array, len(array), ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_int), compare_fn)

    # Convert the sorted ctypes array back to a Python list
    return list(c_array)

def assert_test():
    """Runs assertion tests to validate the heapsort implementation."""
    # Test case 1: Basic sorting
    array = [5, 3, 8, 6, 2]
    sorted_array = heapsort(array)
    assert sorted_array == [2, 3, 5, 6, 8], f"Test case 1 failed: {sorted_array}"

    # Test case 2: Already sorted array
    array = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    sorted_array = heapsort(array)
    assert sorted_array == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], f"Test case 2 failed: {sorted_array}"

    # Test case 3: Reverse sorted array
    array = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1]
    sorted_array = heapsort(array)
    assert sorted_array == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], f"Test case 3 failed: {sorted_array}"

    # Test case 4: Array with duplicates
    array = [4, 2, 4, 3, 2]
    sorted_array = heapsort(array)
    assert sorted_array == [2, 2, 3, 4, 4], f"Test case 4 failed: {sorted_array}"

    # Test case 5: Empty array
    array = []
    sorted_array = heapsort(array)
    assert sorted_array == [], f"Test case 5 failed: {sorted_array}"

    # Test case 6: Single element array
    array = [42]
    sorted_array = heapsort(array)
    assert sorted_array == [42], f"Test case 6 failed: {sorted_array}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
